businesses.business: enterprise data storage and cloud data management

offering_description.value: Sells enterprise data storage systems, data management software and cloud storage services to businesses and government agencies. Products include all-flash and hybrid storage arrays running ONTAP software, plus native cloud storage services on major public clouds. Delivered as hardware, software, subscriptions and support.

primary_products.value: all-flash storage arrays; hybrid storage arrays; data management software; object storage systems; converged infrastructure

primary_services.value: technical support and maintenance; professional and consulting services; cloud storage and data services; managed and subscription services

customer_segment.value: B2B: large enterprises, cloud providers, service providers across industries; B2G: federal, state and local government agencies

end_markets.value: financial services; healthcare; technology; government; manufacturing; media and entertainment

revenue_model.value: product sales: storage hardware systems and perpetual software licenses; subscription: cloud services and software subscriptions; service fees: support contracts, maintenance and professional services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs storage systems built with contract manufacturers, sold to enterprises; software / platform: data management software and cloud storage services sold to enterprises and cloud users

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: storage hardware, data management software, cloud data services and support

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: value-added resellers, system integrators and distributors, the main channel; direct sales: sales teams for large enterprise and government accounts; online: cloud marketplaces of major public cloud providers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business, export control, data privacy and government procurement rules
